page.title: Expense Analytics
page.description: Explore expense trends, approval outcomes, categories, and spending patterns.

metrics.totalSpendHint: Sum of all expense amounts in the selected period (excluding drafts).
metrics.expenseCountHint: Total number of expense submissions in the selected period.
metrics.medianExpenseHint: The middle value when expenses are sorted by amount. Less affected by outliers than the average.
metrics.approvalRateHint: Approved decisions ÷ (approved + rejected). Pending expenses are not counted. Shows '—' when no decisions have been made.
metrics.pendingAmountHint: Total amount in expenses that are still awaiting a decision.
metrics.approvedAmountHint: Total amount in approved or paid expenses.
metrics.activeSubmittersHint: Number of distinct employees who submitted at least one expense in this period.

charts.activityOverTimeDesc: Amount and count of expenses per time bucket.
charts.workflowSnapshotDesc: Expenses by status group — pending, approved, and rejected.
charts.spendByCategoryDesc: Top categories ranked by total spend.
charts.categoryTrendDesc: Top 5 categories over the selected period.
charts.amountDistributionDesc: Number of expenses by amount range.
charts.cumulativeSpendDesc: Running total of spend across the period.
charts.spendByWeekdayDesc: Which days of the week see the most activity.
charts.statusBreakdownDesc: Count and amount for every expense status.
charts.pendingAgingDesc: How long pending expenses have been waiting for a decision.
charts.topEmployeesDesc: Employees ranked by total expense amount.
charts.topDestinationsDesc: Locations and vendors ranked by spend.
charts.highestExpensesDesc: The 10 largest individual expenses in this period.

insights.title: Quick Insights
insights.description: Automatically derived from the current data.
insights.topCategory: {{category}} represents {{pct}}% of spending in this period.
insights.spendIncreased: Spending increased by {{pct}}% compared with the previous period.
insights.spendDecreased: Spending decreased by {{pct}}% compared with the previous period.
insights.pendingShare: {{pct}}% of expenses are still pending a decision.
insights.topWeekday: {{day}} has the highest expense activity this period.
insights.categoryConcentration: The top 3 categories account for {{pct}}% of total spend.
insights.noInsights: Not enough data to generate insights for this period.

loading.initialLoadHint: Fetching expense records for the selected period.
loading.refreshingHint: Showing the previous results while the selected period is recalculated.

errors.loadFailedHint: Showing the last successfully loaded results.

empty.pageDesc: No expense data is available for the selected filters.
empty.noPending: No pending expenses in this period.
empty.noFinalized: No finalized decisions in this period.

export.title: Export Analytics
export.description: Download a workbook with the current analytics data.
export.disabledWhileRefreshing: Export disabled while analytics are refreshing.
export.basedOnStaleData: Export is based on the last successfully loaded data.
